editorial:
Imagine living in the fancy world of 1920s Britain where people are supposed to be proper, but behind closed doors, everything is a mess. You follow Robert Graves, a war poet who seems to have it all with a wife and four kids. Then he meets Laura Riding, a bold American writer, and things get wild. Instead of a normal affair, Laura moves right into the house, and they start living as a trio. Just when you think it cannot get any more crowded, a handsome Irish poet named Geoffrey Phibbs joins the mix. It starts as a romantic dream, but it quickly turns into a nightmare of jealousy and fighting.

What really works here is how the movie shows the tension building between these big personalities. The acting is solid, and you can feel the drama heating up until someone almost ends up dead. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the shock of the murder attempt keeps you guessing. If you like stories about messy relationships and old-school scandals, you should definitely check this one out. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or rent it on Apple TV for a crisp picture.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up as the romantic chaos turns into a legal battle. After the fight for power and love peaks, Robert Graves finds himself under suspicion for attempted murder. The twist is seeing how the love triangle turned into a dangerous rivalry. In the end, the group falls apart because they cannot handle the jealousy. You see that their attempt to live outside the rules of society only led to pain and betrayal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves historical dramas and messy love stories.
